"""Synthetic example only; it is not a real project."""
PROVIDERS = ("openai", "anthropic", "local")

def select_provider(config, name):
    """Return one provider configuration from the saved settings."""
    if name not in PROVIDERS:
        raise ValueError("unknown provider")
    return config["providers"][name]
